messages:
Amelia: Quick sync — trying to lock SOC2 + audit logs + KMS/HSM launch criteria for Q3. Need decisions by EOW. Main asks from customers: long-term audit retention (5-7y), HSM-backed key option, and PII redaction hooks. Any immediate blockers?

Raj: OK. We need to separate 'SOC2 baseline' vs 'enterprise HSM offering'. Baseline: encrypted-at-rest with KMS (cloud), complete audit logging to long-term storage, retention policy config, and documented control mapping. Stretch: customer-managed HSM and on-prem key injection.

Lina: From compliance POV baseline must cover CC6, CC7 (access & encryption) and log integrity (sufficient chain of custody). Retention config + tamper-evident audit logs are required for audits. 5y is reasonable but some customers asked for 7y.

Chris: Tech note — long retention increases storage and egress cost. We can support bucket lifecycle + cold tiering. Need to decide default retention and whether it's per-customer override.

Amelia: Proposal: default retention = 1 year (to minimize cost), paid addon for 5/7yr. MVP launch criteria require retention config applied per-org and exportable audit bundles for auditor requests. Thoughts?

Raj: +1 to per-org override. For audit integrity MVP: append-only write path with signed log entries and an HMAC chain. Not full HSM but we can rotate a KMS key and publish verification metadata.

Morgan: Sales input — top enterprise customers will push hard on HSM and 7yr retention. But most SMBs don't need >1yr. Having a paid tier is okay. We need clear messaging and pricing before GA.

Devon: Legal: ensure export format meets eDiscovery requirements. Also add a clause about customer responsibility for retention if they opt into too-long retention (data residency considerations).

Chris: Implementation risks: 1) Perf hit for synchronous signing of every log entry; 2) Key management complexity for HSM option. We can batch-sign blocks of log entries to reduce perf, but that complicates replay and chunk verification.

Raj: Suggest acceptance criteria (MVP):
- Audit logs capture: request metadata, model used, model version, user id (pseudonymized), request/response hashes
- Per-org retention configurable in Console and via API
- Exportable signed audit bundle for a given time range
- KMS-backed envelope encryption for critical secrets (cloud KMS)
- SOC2 control mapping doc for all implemented controls

Amelia: That looks good. Add launch criteria for security review signoff and one successful customer pilot export.

Lina: Also need a documented incident escalation path and retention deletion SLA for when customers request redaction. Add a small RBAC matrix for audit access.

Raj: For HSM offering we should scope as "private preview" — not GA. Tasks: prototype key wrapping + HSM attestation, cost/ops runbook, and legal T&Cs.

Chris: Rough timelines: MVP implementation 6 weeks (logs + retention UI + export). HSM preview additional 8-10 weeks. Need 2 FTEs from infra + 1 security eng.

Amelia: Can we get a short config sample for Console/infra team to estimate effort?

Raj: Sure — example retention API body:
```
POST /orgs/:id/retention
{
  "retention_days": 365,
  "archive_tier": "cold",
  "audit_signing": "hmac-v1"
}
```

Chris: + config for HSM preview (example):
```
PUT /orgs/:id/keys
{
  "key_source": "customer_hsm",
  "attestation": "true",
  "wrap_mode": "envelope"
}
```

Morgan: Can we get a short FAQ for sales re: what baseline gives vs HSM preview? I can draft once we confirm features.

Devon: I'll prep the legal checklist for HSM preview (export controls, contract addendum).

ops-bot: Reminder — weekly roadmap sync Thu 10:00.

Amelia: Action items: Raj — prototype signed export + log schema by Wed (owner). Chris — cost estimate for 1/5/7yr retention and infra FTEs by Fri. Lina — control mapping draft by Thu. Morgan — sales FAQ draft by Fri. Devon — legal checklist by Fri. Will follow up in roadmap sync. :white_check_mark:
